track: 28.07 Session 2 · Phase 15 Admin OS device walk
summary: Frontend-only device walk with super-admin (jaymn.judd@mascigc.com). Login OK, all reachable admin sub-pages render with no console errors and no raw ISO/UTC/GMT timestamps in labels. However, two spec URLs are unrouted (404), Cmd+K global search leaks synthetic TEST_/Cert data to a super-admin operator, and every PortalShell-hosted /admin/* page horizontally overflows at 390x844.

desktop_1920x800.overflow: none on any tested admin/* or /admin/executive-overview page
desktop_1920x800.portalshell_nesting: Visually a single PortalShell + single SideNavV3 on /admin (see screenshot). class-name based count returned 16/2 due to nested wrappers/testids sharing the class token, not visible nesting.
desktop_1920x800.console_errors: none captured on any visited page

tablet_768x1024.overflow: none on any tested admin route (admin, storage-recovery, ai-operations, communications, diagnostics, maintenance, operations-control, executive-overview)

mobile_390x844.overflow: YES on every PortalShell-hosted admin page. document.scrollWidth = 402–409 vs innerWidth 390. Offender chain rooted at header .ml-auto.flex.items-center.gap-4.text-sm (top-bar utility cluster with SEARCH/NOTIF/PORTAL/CLOCK/EN-ES/AVATAR/SIGN-OUT). Screenshot shows the page title 'Admin Operating System' being wrapped one-glyph-per-line because content column is squeezed to ~55px next to a persistent left sidenav that is not collapsing at this breakpoint.

defects_found.expected: Trust cards render with status + source endpoint + local-time last-checked
defects_found.actual: 404 · PAGE NOT FOUND. AppRoutes.jsx exposes the surface at /admin/operations-control (component OperationsControlCenter), not /admin/occ. Missing alias or spec-vs-impl drift.

defects_found.expected: Executive KPI dashboard with drilldowns, no TEST_28_07_ rows
defects_found.actual: 404 · PAGE NOT FOUND at /executive. Actual live surface is /admin/executive-overview (v15.50.1) which does render KPI counts (192 units OOS, 4 projects with no DR, 78 open corrective actions, 1 WPV in 90d) and 8 attention jobs (22-4B-DR, FT-JOB-*). No synthetic TEST_28_07_ rows observed in the rendered KPI copy. Missing top-level /executive alias.

defects_found.expected: returns real employees + projects only, no synthetic/TEST_/cert leakage
defects_found.actual: Query 'safety' returned to super-admin: NOTIFICATIONS 'Safety Meeting — TEST_28_06_Toolbox Talk', 'New task: Safety Meeting — TEST_28_06_Toolbox Talk', 'New task: Offboarding: TEST_28_04_Employee_chain_1783725221802 …', 'New task: Offboarding: TEST_28_04_Employee_rehire_1783725210666 …', 'Safety Meeting — Track 28.02B Cert Toolbox Talk', DOCUMENT EXPIRATIONS 'TEST_iter151_safety_doc' (2026-07-26), TASKS 'Incident follow-up — Near Miss (Phase Sigma-III Public Form Cert)' repeated 6× (duplicate rows also a bug).
defects_found.impact: Truthfulness violation for operator-facing surface; also implies test/cert seeds were not purged from the preview DB.

defects_found.expected: no horizontal overflow on any Admin OS domain page
defects_found.actual: scrollWidth 402–409 > 390 innerWidth on /admin, /admin/storage-recovery, /admin/ai-operations, /admin/communications, /admin/diagnostics, /admin/maintenance. Top-bar utility row (.ml-auto flex items-center gap-4 text-sm, 337px) plus non-collapsing SideNavV3 forces content column to ~55px, causing the H1 to render one glyph per line (screenshot captured).
defects_found.root_cause_hypothesis: SideNavV3 is not collapsing under md breakpoint on Admin OS; PortalShell top-bar has too many always-visible utility chips (SEARCH ⌘K, notif badge, SWITCH PORTAL, clock, EN/ES, avatar, HOME, SIGN OUT) with fixed gap-4.

action_items_for_main_agent: Add /admin/occ redirect/alias → /admin/operations-control (or rename the canonical route to /admin/occ per spec).
Add top-level /executive route (alias or component) — currently only /admin/executive-overview exists.

CRITICAL: Filter GlobalSearch/Cmd+K results to exclude synthetic/test rows (TEST_*, *Cert Toolbox Talk*, Phase Sigma-III Public Form Cert, TEST_iter151_*). Either purge these seeds from the preview DB or add server-side filter (is_synthetic / __test__ flag).

CRITICAL: Fix mobile responsive on Admin OS PortalShell (390px). SideNavV3 must collapse to drawer/hamburger under md; top-bar utility cluster must condense (icon-only, overflow menu, or hide clock/EN-ES/portal-switch on <md).
Deduplicate Cmd+K results — 'Incident follow-up — Near Miss (Phase Sigma-III Public Form Cert)' rendered 6× identically under TASKS.

Re-verify deep card content on Storage & Recovery (R2 probe + backup freshness + delete-buttons-disabled), AI Ops (demo_mode chip truthfulness), Communications (route config + digest schedule), Diagnostics/Maintenance (dry-run vs apply guard) — this walk only confirmed no console errors + no ISO timestamps at page level.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Spec URLs /admin/occ and /executive are 404 in the live build; use /admin/operations-control and /admin/executive-overview for deep card assertions until aliases land. Cmd+K synthetic leakage may indicate seeds still in preview DB — coordinate with a backend/DB cleanup before re-running the truthfulness check. Mobile overflow root-cause is the non-collapsing SideNavV3 + wide top-bar cluster; verify by checking that at 390px only a hamburger + condensed top-bar are visible.
